category: market data API (end-of-day prices, splits, dividends, forex, crypto)

free_tier.stated: Free plan: 20 API calls a day, plus 500 welcome-bonus calls, past year of data only, your own key and no credit card; up to 1,000 requests per minute
free_tier.notes: Most calls cost 1 API call; intraday, technical and news cost 5, fundamentals and options 10, whole-exchange bulk 100. The daily count resets at midnight GMT. Bulk downloads and fundamentals are not on the Free plan. The first paid plan is EOD Historical All-World at USD 19.99 a month with 100,000 calls a day.

retention.notes: Free history is the past year of every ticker; paid plans give 30+ years.

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the daily call count bounds a Free key

interface_detail: GET https://eodhd.com/api/eod/TICKER.US?api_token=TOKEN&fmt=json; a keyless call answered HTTP 401
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; Python and R libraries and Excel and Google Sheets add-ons exist
chaining: Free end-of-day prices for a year of any ticker at 20 calls a day; Tiingo and Alpha Vantage cover the same ground.

limits.value: 20 API calls per day on the Free plan, reset at midnight GMT
